name: Olvar D
summary: Kahl-175 を支える Corpus の乗組員
> Olvar D is a Corpus Crewman that supports Kahl-175. He joins Kahl's Garrison at Rank 4 - Settlement with the Syndicate.
> He provides no services nor can he be directly spoken to, acting as an aesthetic to Kahl's growing camp.
sections: - Because Olvar shows surprise when learning that the Solaris do not like what they experience, as well as singing a line from We All Lift Together, it is likely that prior to the New War, he was stationed at Fortuna under the employ of Nef Anyo.
